title: Turn Around · Audio · s01_l01
caption: Narrator — Deep underground, prisoners face a wall. They've been chained here since childhood.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s01_l02
caption: Narrator — They can speak, but their necks and legs cannot move.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s01_l03
caption: Prisoner — You still there?

title: Turn Around · Audio · s01_l04
caption: Elder — Still here. Same wall. Spectacular view.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s01_l05
caption: Narrator — They know one another's voices. They've never seen one another's faces.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s01_l06
caption: Narrator — Behind them burns a fire. They don't know that either.

title: Turn Around · Audio · foley-s01
caption: The Whole World — sfx

title: Turn Around · Audio · s02_l01
caption: Narrator — Behind a low wall, people carry objects past the fire.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s02_l02
caption: Narrator — A clay jar. A wooden horse. A carved bird. Their shadows cross the prisoners' wall.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s02_l03
caption: Prisoner — The bird's talking!

title: Turn Around · Audio · s02_l04
caption: Elder — Of course. Hear that voice? Definitely a bird.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s02_l05
caption: Narrator — A carrier speaks. The cave echoes. The prisoners give the voice to the shadow.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s02_l06
caption: Prisoner — Well, that's what a bird is. Isn't it?

title: Turn Around · Audio · s02_l07
caption: Narrator — They know the names. They haven't met the things.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s03_song
caption: Chorus — Turn around? Keep your eyes ahead. / Trust the wall, and the life we've led. / Count the shapes and believe your eyes. / Nothing lives where the shadow dies.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s03_l01
caption: Prisoner — Horse, then jar. Wait for it... There! Never wrong.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s03_l02
caption: Elder — Our great thinker. Another triumph over the wall.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s03_l03
caption: Narrator — Correct predictions win praise. He becomes an expert in a world he has never questioned.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s03_l04
caption: Prisoner — What else is there to know?

title: Turn Around · Audio · s03_l05
caption: Narrator — He can predict a shadow. He cannot imagine its source.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s03_l06
caption: Elder — That's enough questions. You're missing the horse.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s04_l01
caption: Narrator — Then someone unlocks him. Our guide takes his hand.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s04_l02
caption: Guide — Up you get.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s04_l03
caption: Prisoner — Ow! Wonderful. I'm free to fall over.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s04_l04
caption: Guide — Easy. Those legs are new at this.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s04_l05
caption: Prisoner — I liked them better sitting down.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s04_l06
caption: Narrator — His neck aches. He wants his old place back.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s04_l07
caption: Guide — Turn around. Just a little.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s04_l08
caption: Narrator — Freedom begins with a movement that feels completely wrong.

title: Turn Around · Audio · foley-s04
caption: Up You Get — sfx

title: Turn Around · Audio · s05_l01
caption: Narrator — The fire blinds him. The guide holds up a jar.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s05_l02
caption: Guide — Recognise it?

title: Turn Around · Audio · s05_l03
caption: Prisoner — Obviously not. The real one's enormous.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s05_l04
caption: Guide — Watch. Same jar. Closer to the fire. Bigger shadow.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s05_l05
caption: Prisoner — Stop moving it! I knew things before you arrived.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s05_l06
caption: Narrator — The familiar picture feels truer than the object. Being corrected hasn't made him understand.
